title: ICA-UAP-D001, Analysis: Colorado Springs UAP Incident, 2022
what_is_it: An analytical assessment image document by an Intelligence Community partner of AARO examining a 2022 UAP sighting near Colorado Springs, Colorado.
interpretation_warnings: No extracted body text available — all facts derived from metadata and the CSV description provided by war.gov.
The document is an image file (JPG), so content details beyond the catalogue description are unavailable without viewing the image directly.
The IC partner's assessment carries only low confidence, meaning the explanation is considered possible but far from certain.
Single-source analytical assessment from an unnamed IC partner; the specific agency is not identified.
The incident remains officially unresolved despite the proposed natural explanation.

verifiable_claims.claim: U.S. military service members reported an airborne object sighting near Colorado Springs in 2022 to AARO in 2023.
